text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—Tonight...
Bar Gimlet is open for business."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. Invited by Tanino Gimlet, I visited the bar where she worked.
She was waiting at the reserved counter seat—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For a solemn holy night,
intoxication is most fitting...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The first drink is a Gin and Tonic.
The very first cocktail a bartender learns to make.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it's a mocktail this time.
Now... let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I had no solid foundation...
Nothing that could truly be called an ego.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet explained without missing a beat, his hands moving with practiced ease as he finished the drink.
Then, the glass was set down before me—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet through repeated cycles of destruction and rebirth—
IT was born... nay, reborn.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"—A primordial fragment, reconstructed by the current me.
Please, take a sip."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a sip just as offered.
And then—an incredible shock awaited me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Don't stop! Drink it all down!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Paradise is waiting on the other side... Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trust me... Hearing her say that, I have no choice but to do so.
Steeling my resolve, I swallowed it down and...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hahaa! Correct!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A sharp bitterness gives rise to sweetness.
Within it... yes, lies true pleasure."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... But this falls short of a blessing fit for the gods.
Now, let us gradually raise the proof!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The second drink is...
a short cocktail.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A short cocktail is,
truly, like a fleeting rendezvous...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Poured into an iceless glass, its optimal temperature window is brief, demanding it be drunk without delay.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shaken up, fleeting in a single moment...
In other words...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It's a roller coaster!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Kuh-kuh-kuh... Haaahahah! Come, dance in madness... O Dragon! I am right hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Not shaken enough yet...!
Come on—one more lap! Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after being thoroughly "shaken" on the roller coaster—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
âAnd lastly...
Straight, no mixer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: In other words: me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh... You don't understand?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Reigning and ruling over this night... Savor my majestic presence to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'Reign'—standing at the very top... In other words, does that mean heading for the top of the tower?
There certainly is a way out up there. But—"
choice_data_list: Isn't the summit off-limits at this hour...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Feast your eyes!
Behold this holy night becoming mine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's not getting through at all!
Could it be because of how hyper they are?
I have to stop them somehow.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The exhaustion from riding all those roller coasters
finally caught up to me just now..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
My semicircular canals! You got the jump on me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I gracefully concede defeat!
There's no beating someone who went crazy before me!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then—Trainer, I'll lend you my back.
Up... we go.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! It is no different from picking up
the feather of a seraph.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
Now let us return to our cradle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while Tanino Gimlet carried me on her back and let out a boisterous laugh,
we headed home...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's not getting through at all!
Could it be because of how hyper they are?
I have to stop them somehow.
choice_data_list: …It's pointless if you're trying to get me drunk!
...If you're trying to get me drunk, it's useless!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho?
...And your reason?
choice_data_list: Because I'm already totally intoxicated by you!
Because I'm already intoxicated by you!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Has a nice ring to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though the words came out on reflex, they seemed to strike a chord with her. If I can skillfully steer the conversation toward heading home now...!
choice_data_list: Getting any dizzier would be toxic...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"No further"... is it?
Why do you hesitate?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you afraid of falling?
Because you know that once you do, there is no returning?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, how absurd.
Cast away reason... and drink from the poisoned chalice.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Prepare yourself to go mad for me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
—Just a bit of fun.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Trainer.
To the good kid who didn't fall for the devil's temptation—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas.
I shall grant you moments of exquisite beauty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When child's play like this no longer satisfies you...
climb the ladder.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I will be there.
...Most likely."
